data.name: ToolTemplateDefinition
data.value:
--- description: Counts lines in the files of a folder parameters: path: Folder relative to the workspace root pattern: File mask, for example *.cs ---
The agent sees the description and the parameters and calls the tool with run_tool; you run it from the Tools menu or the palette.
The script next to this file (run.ps1, run.mjs or run.cs) runs in the workspace root and gets the parameters as -path value (PowerShell) or --path value (Node.js, C#) and in BREEZE_ARG_PATH. What it prints goes to the agent or to the Output panel. A non-zero exit code means failure. Optional settings: run: script file name; timeout: seconds (default 120).

data.name: ToolTemplateScript
data.value:
param( [string]$path = ".", [string]$pattern = "*" )
$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $path -Filter $pattern -Recurse -File $lines = ($files | Get-Content | Measure-Object -Line).Lines "$($files.Count) files, $lines lines"
